text.label: Text: You know something other people want to learn. You just cann
text.value: You know something other people want to learn. You just cannot write the check yet.

text.label: Text: Our done-for-you clients pay $30,000.00 to $50,000.00 up fro
text.value: Our done-for-you clients pay $30,000.00 to $50,000.00 up front for the build. Most of them already sell what they know and already have a small team around them. Plenty of good people are not there yet. They have spent years getting good at one thing, and they cannot write that check today. That should not keep them off the stage.

text.label: Text: So this is the other way in. We call it the Revenue Share Pa
text.value: So this is the other way in. We call it the Revenue Share Partnership. It is the same agency, the same team and the same work. You pay a small piece to start, and the rest is paid out of what the build sells for you. You do not need a big audience to begin. Getting you the attention is part of what we build. What we need first is to know who you are, what you know and who it helps.

text.label: Text: Two things are different, and I would rather you hear them f
text.value: Two things are different, and I would rather you hear them from me now. You do not start the day you decide, because we choose who we work with. And you pay more in total than a person who writes the whole check up front. Everything else is the same work, done by the same people.

text.label: Text: Each month we choose one or two members of our community to
text.value: Each month we choose two or three members of our community to talk with. We keep it that small on purpose. My team and I do the building, and we will not take on more than we can do well. If it is not you this month, stay close and keep showing us what you are working on. We notice who does.

text.label: Text: The idea
text.value: The idea

text.label: Heading: Why we call ourselves a talent agency.
text.value: Why we call ourselves a talent agency.

text.label: Text: The oldest deal there is.
text.value: The oldest deal there is.

text.label: Text: A singer or an athlete with a gift has always had somebody b
text.value: A singer or an athlete with a gift has always had somebody behind them. The talent agent does the work nobody sees: the bookings, the deals, the business side. The talent shows up and does the one thing they are great at. The talent agent gets paid out of what the talent earns. That arrangement has been around as long as show business. We do the same thing for people who know something other people want to learn.

text.label: Text: It is the whole company.
text.value: It is the whole company.

text.label: Text: Steven James Consulting is a modern day talent agency. That
text.value: Steven James Consulting is a modern day talent agency. That is what the whole company is, and Revenue Share is one way in. When somebody asks me what I do for a living, that is my answer. My team and I take coaches, authors, speakers and influencers and show them how to make money with their attention and their product, and then we do the heavy end of the work for them. Our done-for-you clients get the same agency behind them. The only thing that changes on this page is how the build gets paid for.

text.label: Text: We go first.
text.value: We go first.

text.label: Text: Here is what a talent agent does that almost nobody else in
text.value: Here is what a talent agent does that almost nobody else in business will do. He does the work before he is paid for it. He backs a person on what they know and what he believes they can become, long before there is anything to split. That is the Revenue Share Partnership in plain words. My team builds first, and most of what we are owed comes later, out of what the build sells. We are choosing to believe in you with our own hours. That is why we say everybody gets a shot, and why we take our time choosing.

text.label: Text: What a talent agent does.
text.value: What a talent agent does.

text.label: Text: Whatever you do for a living, you have to promote yourself t
text.value: Whatever you do for a living, you have to promote yourself to make it work. Most people were never shown how. So the first job of a modern day talent agent is to show you how to promote yourself on the free platforms, and then my team carries the heavy end of it for you. The second is to package what you know into something a person can buy. The third is to build the modern website and the sales system that sells it. We call that sales system our proprietary Revenue Engine. I do not see anybody else offering all of that in one place.

text.label: Text: What is missing.
text.value: What is missing.

text.label: Text: Our whole model is one line: Attention + Your Product = Doll
text.value: Our whole model is one line: Attention + Your Product = Dollars. Three things have to stand behind the stage for that line to add up. A website you own, so the people watching you have one address to go to. Something with your name on it that a person can pay for, so their interest has somewhere to land. And a way to stay in front of them until they are ready, so you are still there on the day they decide. You bring the knowledge and the face. Those three are the part we build.

text.label: Text: Who this is for.
text.value: Who this is for.

text.label: Text: The coach with a handful of clients who all came by word of
text.value: The coach with a handful of clients who all came by word of mouth. The author with a book and nowhere to send the readers who liked it. The person with a small following who answers the same five questions in their messages every week. You know your subject. People already come to you for it. You have just never had a business built behind you, and you cannot pay for the whole build today.

text.label: Text: If you can pay today.
text.value: If you can pay today.

text.label: Text: If you already sell what you know, have a small team and can
text.value: If you already sell what you know, have a small team and can write the check, our done-for-you service on the home page is the straighter road. You do not wait to be picked and the total is lower. Both doors lead into the same agency. If you cannot tell which door is yours, fill in the application on this page and say so. Every client starts with a discovery call, and that call is where we work it out together.

text.label: Text: What gets built
text.value: What gets built

text.label: Heading: The same build our done-for-you clients get, piece by piece.
text.value: The same build our done-for-you clients get, piece by piece.

text.label: Text: A website you own.
text.value: A website you own.

text.label: Text: This comes first because everything else points to it. Your
text.value: This comes first because everything else points to it. Your social pages sit on rented land. The platform owns the ground, writes the rules and can change them any day it likes. Your website is yours. It goes in your name from the first day, and it stays with you if we ever part ways. It tells your story, shows what you sell, and lets a person buy or book a call with you right there. Every video, every clip and every episode you put out sends people to that one address.

text.label: Text: Your own e-book.
text.value: Your own e-book.

text.label: Text: We sit down with what you know and package it into a book wi
text.value: We sit down with what you know and package it into a book with your name on the cover. It lives on your website and people buy it there. Think about what that does for you. A stranger who watched one clip now has something of yours to read, in your words, laid out start to finish. It is the first thing a person can buy from you, and it tells them you are the real thing.

text.label: Text: Your own podcast.
text.value: Your own podcast.

text.label: Text: Your show, on your website, the same way mine is on my websi
text.value: Your show, on your website, the same way mine is on my website. You sit down and talk about what you know. My team produces it and puts it out. If you have never done one, do not worry about the equipment or the technical side. That is our job. Your job is to show up every week with something to say.

text.label: Text: The content engine.
text.value: The content engine.

text.label: Text: This is the self-promotion, and we carry the heavy end of it
text.value: This is the self-promotion, and we carry the heavy end of it. One recording from you does not stay one recording. We turn it into a steady run of videos, clips and episodes across every platform your audience is on. You record once and you show up everywhere, all week. Every piece carries the same instruction for the viewer: go to the website. That is how free attention ends up on a piece of the internet you own.

text.label: Text: Somebody always answers.
text.value: Somebody always answers.

text.label: Text: When a person comments, sends a message or fills in a form,
text.value: When a person comments, sends a message or fills in a form, they are interested right now. An hour later they have moved on. So an AI employee answers every one of them in seconds, day or night, and keeps the conversation going. You stop losing buyers because you were asleep, on a call, or having dinner with your family.

text.label: Text: Proof and second chances.
text.value: Proof and second chances.

text.label: Text: Every person you help gets asked for a testimonial, every ti
text.value: Every person you help gets asked for a testimonial, every time, without you remembering to ask. The next buyer sees that proof before they ever talk to you. And everyone who followed you, bought once or went quiet gets reached again with something else you offer. Those people already know you. That is the easiest money you will ever make.

text.label: Text: Paid ads come last.
text.value: Paid ads come last.

text.label: Text: We do not start by spending money on advertising. First the
text.value: We do not start by spending money on advertising. First the free attention has to turn into paying clients. Once it does, we add ads on top, and an AI employee answers everything the ads bring in. What reaches you is a call on your calendar with a person who wants what you teach, and never a list of names to chase.

text.label: Text: Who does the work.
text.value: Who does the work.

text.label: Text: Those six systems together are the Revenue Engine. AI employ
text.value: Those six systems together are the Revenue Engine. AI employees run them around the clock. They do the answering, the following up and the asking that no one person could keep up with. My team is behind them, and I am on your account personally. You are not handed a login and a set of lessons. We build it and you get a working copy of my own business with your name on it. Most builds take 4 to 6 weeks from the day we start. That is a range, and I confirm yours on the discovery call.

text.label: Text: If that is the build you want and the check is the only thin
text.value: If that is the build you want and the check is the only thing in the way, tell us about yourself.

text.label: Heading: How the money works, one step at a time.
text.value: How the money works, one step at a time.

text.label: Text: First, a call.
text.value: First, a call.

text.label: Text: It starts with a conversation. When your name comes up, we g
text.value: It starts with a conversation. When your name comes up, we get on a discovery call. We talk about what you know, who it helps, what you could sell and what the build would look like for you. This is also where you hear your exact numbers, because no two people get the same ones. You ask us anything you want. Both sides decide whether it is a fit.

text.label: Text: Then, one number in writing.
text.value: Then, one number in writing.

text.label: Text: Before any work begins, we agree two numbers and write them
text.value: Before any work begins, we agree two numbers and write them down: the total for your build, and the share of revenue that goes toward it. The total is higher than the up-front price. As an example, a build that is $40,000.00 paid up front might come to $55,000.00 or $60,000.00 paid over time. You see both numbers before you pay anything.

text.label: Text: $3,995.00 to start.
text.value: $3,995.00 to start.

text.label: Text: That is what you pay up front. It is real money, and it is m
text.value: That is what you pay up front. It is real money, and it is meant to be. It tells us you are serious about this, and it puts our whole team to work on your build. Compare it to the $30,000.00 to $50,000.00 a done-for-you client pays before we begin. You are starting the same build for a small piece of that.

text.label: Text: We build it.
text.value: We build it.

text.label: Text: My team and I do the work: the website, the e-book, the podc
text.value: My team and I do the work: the website, the e-book, the podcast, the six systems and the AI employees that run them. You are not waiting until you can afford the next piece. You get the whole build, the same one, and we carry the cost of it while it gets going.

text.label: Text: The rest comes from what it earns.
text.value: The rest comes from what it earns.

text.label: Text: Once it is running and people are buying from you, a share o
text.value: Once it is running and people are buying from you, a share of that revenue goes toward the total. That is how the rest gets paid. It comes out of money the build brought in. I will not print a percentage on this page, because it is not one number for everybody. I set it with you, person by person, on the discovery call. It sits beside the total, so you can do the arithmetic yourself before you decide.

text.label: Text: Why it costs more.
text.value: Why it costs more.

text.label: Text: Because we do the work first and wait to be paid. It is the
text.value: Because we do the work first and wait to be paid. It is the same reason a house paid off over time costs more than one bought with cash. You are getting the build now without the big check, and we are the ones waiting. The higher total is the price of that.

text.label: Text: Why that is good for you.
text.value: Why that is good for you.

text.label: Text: Look at where it leaves us. The rest comes out of what the b
text.value: Look at where it leaves us. The rest comes out of what the build earns. So we have every reason to build it right, keep it working and help you sell more. That is also why we are careful about who we work with each month. We are putting our own work on the line next to yours.

text.label: Text: What you have by then.
text.value: What you have by then.

text.label: Text: Some of it is yours for certain, because we build it and put
text.value: Some of it is yours for certain, because we build it and put it in your name. A website you own. An e-book with your name on the cover. A podcast that is your show. The rest is what your weekly work stacks on top of that: the audience that knows where to find you, the testimonials from people you helped, and the buyers who come back for the next thing. We build the first part. You and the Revenue Engine build the second part together, week by week. You started with something you knew. The aim is a business built around it.

text.label: Text: Why we do it this way.
text.value: Why we do it this way.

text.label: Text: I have run five businesses over forty years, and the deals t
text.value: I have run five businesses over forty years, and the deals that lasted were the ones where both sides came out ahead. You get a business you could not have paid for on day one. We get paid more than our up-front price for waiting. Then we shake hands and you keep what you built. The website, the list, the e-book, the podcast and the accounts are in your name the whole way through, and they stay with you if we ever part ways. That is what a modern day talent agency is for: get you seen, get you paid, and leave you owning all of it.

text.value: What we look for

text.label: Heading: People who show up and are ready to be s
text.value: People who show up and are ready to be seen.

text.label: Text: Here is the order. Join our free community, which is the fro
text.value: Here is the order. Join our free community, which is the front door to this partnership. Then fill in the application at the bottom of this page so we know who you are. The people we call each month come from the ones who did both. After that, let us see you. If you have already helped somebody with what you know, even one person, tell us that story. If you have a video of yourself explaining it, send it. That is the fastest way for us to get to know you.

text.label: Text: What catches our eye is simple. A person who can say plainly
text.value: What catches our eye is simple. A person who can say plainly who they help and what they help them do. A real story about somebody they helped. A clip where they explain it in their own words. If you have never sold any of it yet, that is fine. Packaging what you know and selling it is our half of the work. Knowing it and saying it out loud is yours.

text.value: Ready now? Apply below and tell us about it.

text.label: Text: What you bring
text.value: What you bring

text.label: Heading: The part we cannot build for you.
text.value: The part we cannot build for you.

text.label: Text: You, on camera, every week.
text.value: You, on camera, every week.

text.label: Text: Everything we build runs on one thing only you can supply: y
text.value: Everything we build runs on one thing only you can supply: you, talking about what you know. We can show you how to promote yourself, and my team can turn one recording into a week of videos and clips. We cannot make the recording. If you go quiet for a month, the whole thing goes quiet with you. So this is the commitment we ask for: sit down every week and do it.

text.label: Text: Your own podcast.
text.value: Your own podcast.

text.label: Text: A podcast is the easiest way there is to show people you kno
text.value: A podcast is the easiest way there is to show people you know your subject. It is also where a lot of people freeze. You do not have to be polished. Polished comes with practice, and nobody starts there. Willing has to be there on day one. A show with your name on it means people will hear how you think, and that is exactly why it works.

text.label: Text: Your own product.
text.value: Your own product.

text.label: Text: You will have an e-book with your name on the cover and a pr
text.value: You will have an e-book with your name on the cover and a price on it, and you will be asking people to buy what you know. Some people are comfortable giving advice away and uncomfortable charging for it. We can package it and we can sell it. You have to be willing to stand behind it and say it is worth paying for. If having your own podcast and your own product scares you, we are not the right fit, and it is better to know that now.

text.label: Text: What your week looks like.
text.value: What your week looks like.

text.label: Text: You record. You talk to the people who are ready to buy. You
text.value: You record. You talk to the people who are ready to buy. You take care of the people who paid you. That is your week. The answering, the following up, the clips, the testimonials and the going back to people who went quiet are handled by your AI employees and my team. You do the part only you can do.

text.label: Text: Patience.
text.value: Patience.

text.label: Text: People are slow to buy from somebody new, and they should be
text.value: People are slow to buy from somebody new, and they should be. It usually takes seven to ten times of seeing you and hearing you before a stranger trusts you with their money. The Revenue Engine is built to keep you in front of them that long. Your part is to keep showing up while it does. That is the whole reason the weekly commitment matters, and on Revenue Share it matters twice, because the build is paid for out of what those people buy.

text.label: Text: The reps.
text.value: The reps.

text.label: Text: You also need to have done the work. Everybody gets a shot,
text.value: You also need to have done the work. Everybody gets a shot, and the people who make the most of it are the ones who put in the hours before they ever met us. An audience can tell when somebody has lived what they teach. If you have the knowledge and the reps behind you, we can build everything else around you. If you are still putting them in, keep going, and stay close.
